svg.text: All 25 modules on WSO2 Identity Server and API Manager, with an event backbone, one core database and a separate integration layer.

g.text: M1 to M25 are the module numbers.

svg.text: TLS, security headers, rate limits. Routes portal and API traffic to the gateway.
The one front door. Token and ApiKey checks, throttling, API versions, developer portal for departments.
Sign-in, OTP and MFA, roles from postings, tokens for citizens, officers, operators and departments.
Notifications, payments matching, audit, reports and search all react to events, so a failure in one never undoes a decision.
A secrets vault and a signing-key module. Encrypted storage and backups, restores rehearsed.
The single connection point: retries, timeouts, logs and a named owner for every outside link.
one front door to every service, token checked first
